XenotypeDef.label: Whispers hybrid
XenotypeDef.description: An abandoned early-generation hybrid from Michael's experiments. Human captives were irreversibly altered with Iratus/Wraith and additional predatory traits. These creatures are blind, hunt by sound, emit a predatory fog from neck gills, retain an unstable Life Force reserve that must be replenished by partial feeding, and possess only attenuated Wraith telepathy.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A blind, sound-hunting lesser Wraith with fog, partial feeding, unstable Life Force and attenuated telepathy.
